title: GROMTools: scalable individual-level GReX imputation for mega-biobank-scale cohorts
text: Large-scale genetically regulated omics workflows need compact interface loading prediction weights, streaming genotype data, writing output format can read back efficiently without materializing full matrix memory. gromtools built around workflow. converts model weights sparse binary representation, streams chromosome-split .pgen inputs, computes predicted values using additive SNP effects, writes result -disk .grom matrix matching .gid .sid index files. package designed around three user-facing steps: read model databases, run imputation, read back selected results. Example synthetic inputs full workflow bundled package.

title: GROMTools: scalable individual-level GReX imputation for mega-biobank-scale cohorts
text: GROMTools substantially reduces computational cost genetically regulated gene-expression (GReX) imputation. chromosome 1 benchmarks across 50,000 450,000 individuals, consistently outperformed PLINK2 PrediXcan CPU time peak memory usage. analyses conducted single-threaded machine ensure fair comparison. Across benchmarks, GROMTools 69x 209x faster used 15x 49x less peak memory, depending comparator sample size. makes particularly well suited large-cohort biobank-scale analyses.

title: Impute genetically regulated omics values — grom_impute
text: weights_table `data.frame` `data.table` model weights. grom_pfx Output prefix generated grom files. pgen_dir Path directory containing PLINK2 `.pgen`, `.pvar`, `.psam` files. snp_chunk Integer chunk size used streaming SNPs. Specifies many genotype records loaded time can used control peak average memory usage. sample_subset Integer vector specifying samples load use imputation. CHUNK Integer chunk size passed low-level imputation engine. Specifies tile size used computation can help maintain efficient CPU-cache utilization. exportChunk Integer chunk size used exporting results. Specifies many output columns written time can used control peak average memory usage. meanimpute Logical indicating whether missing dosages mean imputed. is_round Logical indicating whether mean imputation use rounded means.

title: Impute genetically regulated omics values — grom_impute
text: Chromosome--file mapping uses `chromosomes` column `weights_table`. basenames `.pgen` `.pvar` files `pgen_dir` must contain corresponding chromosome tag. example: Matching unique chromosome tag, `chr1` match `chr10`. chromosome tag must resolve exactly one `.pgen` one `.pvar` file. `.psam` file discovered separately chromosome-tag matched. confirm resolved mapping run, inspect generated files `meta/chr_to_pgen_map.tsv` `meta/chr_to_pvar_map.tsv` output directory. record chromosome tag matched genotype file basename.
code: weights_table$chromosomes:   chr1   chr2   chr10  Matching filenames in pgen_dir:   cohort.chr1.pgen   cohort.chr1.pvar   cohort.chr2.pgen   cohort.chr2.pvar   cohort.chr10.pgen   cohort.chr10.pvar

title: Impute genetically regulated omics values — grom_impute
code: library(gromtools)  pgen_dir <- system.file(   "extdata",   "synthetic_chromosomes",   package = "gromtools" ) db_directory <- system.file(   "extdata",   "synth_small_variant_weights_db",   package = "gromtools" ) model_weights_table <- read_db_dir(db_dir = db_directory)  out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "tmp_grom_run") dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE) grom_pfx <- file.path(out_dir, "synth_example")  grom_impute(   weights_table = model_weights_table,   grom_pfx = grom_pfx,   pgen_dir = pgen_dir ) #> All chromosome tags were uniquely mapped to a .pgen file. #> ### impute_grom() started at: 2026-04-20 01:17:03 #> ### impute_grom() completed at: 2026-04-20 01:17:04
